address: Schaafstraat 17, Amsterdam-Noord (Overhoeks industrial estate): 1960 workshop hall with painted cream and grey banded walls and a clerestory glazing strip
notes: Schaafstraat 17 (BAG, 1960; Overhoeks/Noord workshop estate): one long hall 7 m to the eaves with lower annexes (4.8 m) on the north side; 90 3DBAG wall surfaces. Photographed in the 2021-12-24 panorama (w01-169, 70 m south wall), w02-259 (west, 2025-09-04) and w03-79 (east, 2020-05-29, showing the white wall with a turquoise upper band and workshop doors).

walls[0..2] = panels 46 (S), 41 (W) and 55 (E): a painted wall (white/cream over a grey plinth band) topped by a continuous clerestory glazing strip between slim posts about 5 m apart. Drawn as ribbon-windows, 2 storeys, ground storey blank (render) and low windows in the upper storey; the east wall carries the turquoise frame colour. Simplified: the grey plinth band (one wall colour), the workshop roller doors and the west wall bay doors; the north annexes and the roof lights are blank/3DBAG roof; the flat roof is bitumen.
Not drawn: the north and rear fronts and the courts (no panorama within 35 m or only over parked vans and fencing).

Measured 2026-10-14 (measure.ts, evidence in measured.json): groups 0, 1, 2 take the photo's wall and glass colour, window shape, bay count and front class; walls[2] glass #38302f not used (not darker than the wall #47474a by 10 L*, or tinted): kit glass kept.
